releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.23 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Fixed 1-2s Launch Crash: Bumped Room DB to version 3 and added seamless MIGRATION_2_3 to prevent IllegalStateException schema mismatch on existing installs
* Idempotent Database Migrations: Ensured learned patterns and session histories are preserved across app updates
* Crash Dump Logger: Installed global uncaught exception logger to catch and persist any fatal crashes to file
